summary.headline: Geometric Definitions and Angles
summary.text: Definitions of geometric lines and surfaces, including straight and curved lines, planes, circles, centers, radii, chords, arcs, and diameters. The text also explains the 360 degrees of a circle and classifies plane angles as right, obtuse, or acute.
